about: The Lebanon Area Chamber of Commerce hosts this tradition, now in its 37th year.
It takes place Saturday, December 5, 2026, in the historic heart of downtown Lebanon.
Two parades are planned, a daylight parade at 1 PM and a candlelight parade at 7 PM.
The chamber describes dozens of horse-drawn carriages decorated for the season.
The Christmas festival and market runs from 10 AM to 8 PM.
Food trucks, local vendors and holiday shopping fill the festival.
Pictures with Santa are part of the day.
The City of Lebanon adds that Santa, Mrs. Claus and mini-Highlander cows will be at Bicentennial Park, next to the Christmas Market.
This year's parade features a collection of late 1800s horse-drawn fire wagons, according to the city.
The festival is free, and the chamber lists free parking and a shuttle.
Arriving early helps families find a good viewing spot for the parades.
